derived.pressure_basis: ISS cabin nominal total pressure, sea-level equivalent (NASA OCHMO habitable-atmosphere technical brief: 1 atm = 14.7 psia). Operating band about 14.0-14.9 psia (NASA ICES-2025-126) changes pCO2 by about -5% to +1%.
derived.limit_reference: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 V2 6004: average one-hour ppCO2 no more than 3 mmHg (https://www.nasa.gov/reference/6-0-natural-and-induced-environments-vol-2)

citation: NASA OSDR Environmental Data App, https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/eda/ ; radiation data cited as visualization (not a primary dataset).
notes: Values copied unchanged from the EDA; missing values skipped, never filled.
Units from the EDA chart axis labels; accumulated dose is the running sum of daily total dose (EDA tooltip), unit mGy.
EDA timestamps have no time zone; treated as UTC.
confidence = 1 because the EDA gives no quality score; it is not a validated quality measure.
Telemetry is from ISS cabin sensors recorded during this Rodent Research mission; ground-control series excluded.

cabin_pco2 and cabin_pco2_1h are derived from cabin_co2 at ISS nominal pressure (where the air was measured), not the mission profile's cabin_pressure; Reading.source is 'sensor' because the contract has no 'derived' value.
